answer: Spectral analysis at the yarrow: each identity is a node, and the second eigenvalue of the social graph's Laplacian exposes tight sybil clusters. The pulse of honest edges stays high-variance and cross-community, while farm edges cluster. A zephyr of random edge audits samples 5% of links monthly, forcing attackers to fake costly organic ties. Break-even: faking k convincing edges costs O(k²) in maintained trust, exceeding the k rewards sybils extract past roughly eight identities.
